decisions.decision: Resolve the app's today through one appToday function that honours a validated demo-date cookie only in demo mode, on by default outside production, so scenario cards can be replayed on their own dates while domain code still receives dates as arguments.

Sign demo personas in through the library's normal sign-up and sign-in with a password derived from the server auth secret, so persona switching creates no hand-made sessions and no shared credential is stored or committed.
